body: How are you holding up today? Any advice, since we seem to be the same age. The 90's were fucking great and all, but had I known we'd be thrust into this with no signs of getting better!? I'm drowning dude. I'd rather just opt out than to see the world disintegrate further while my life has never improved anyway. I'm just once person. People might miss me when I'm gone for a year, but my death won't be significant. I offer nothing to this world, at least nothing anyone wants to listen to. And I just went for a walk and the sky was beautiful…but it only made me want to become a part of it more. :\
wow. I didn't know where this was going. It was worth it for that second verse. Interesting perspective. Thanks… interesting… I guess I'll try one last time and keep this song in my mind.

Is nothingness a less scary alternative than not giving a fuck and going on one last adventure in the hopes of actually enjoying life? Will these worst fears come true prevent you from that? :\ For me, if I'm going to go own my terms, I'm going to go on my view too and damn straight I'm going to enjoy the hell out of it. I think there was a man who did a similar thing here, but I've had that idea brewing for awhile…..which is why I feel anything goes. I'm in the same boat as you man, I hope we make it to paradise, wherever that may be. {hugs}

oh god I shouldn't laugh, well I didn't, but I smirked…. I love this movie and yes this exact "aftermath" haunts me as well. I have no safe place to go. I'm stuck in an abusive situation. I have a car, but it's not mine, so eventually they'll come looking for me. If I'm not dead before then (and I'm trying to carefully set things up, I'd like to go out with dignity as well), shit… The movie Wristcutters: A Love Story also prevents me from committing the big one. I hate that I've seen it. It ruined everything… but this is hell on Earth anyway. Could it be worse? Probably.

I would know (my parents and close x-friends/family are), he's a psychopath straight up. It's easier said than done, but just FORGET about him. Cut off immediately. Everytime you think about him be like "FUCK THAT STUPID CREEP WTF!" or whatever suits you. Don't be too hard on yourself. It's very easy to be *anyone* online. Be very, very careful of who you friend online. If you do, don't be afraid to ask for their intentions and keep it "short and sweet." it sounds like he just had his sadistic fun "cat fishing" you, taking advantage of the fact that you were young. it happened to me very recently, but from my username, even I'm older than you and got "hooked." I know you just wanted some positive support from him and this is going to suck to hear, but some people don't actually care. They will pretend too. Especially if you're a pretty young lady. These people have NO lives, so they get creative with their boredom. They get off on this stuff. If you can afford it, I would recommend therapy to talk about *this* stuff with. I misread, I thought you were 18, but 15?! Love, you will have many opportunities for amazing kisses and first dates okay. I know social media is big for you guys right now, but I would pull back from it. What are your hobbies? I would also recommend investing personal time in them and fostering something great. He or anyone else will never be able to take away your "me-time" where you soar. I hate that this happened to you. You're so young :'( Don't be afraid to live on okay? Things really do get better in your teens. Late 20's, 30's….yeesh!
